metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Veera, a troubled, obsessive photographer seeking validation, travels deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious forest reserve, to photograph a rare, elusive phenomenon that could transform his life.

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Forrest Gump
metas.description: The history of the United States from the 1950s to the '70s unfolds from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75, who yearns to be reunited with his childhood sweetheart.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Satya
metas.description: An innocent man is embroiled in underworld after being falsely charged and sets out to punish the perpetrators who subjected his life to misery.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Bangalore Days
metas.description: A fun roller coaster ride about three young people, Aju, Divya and Kuttan who are cousins, reach Bangalore to dream, discover and explore.

metas.name: The Big City
metas.description: Life at home changes when a house-wife from a middle-class, conservative family in Calcutta gets a job as a saleswoman.

metas.name: Dangal
metas.description: Mahavir Singh Phogat, a former wrestler, decides to fulfill his dream of winning a gold medal for his country by training his daughters for the Commonwealth Games despite the existing social stigmas.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?

metas.name: Kirik Party
metas.description: Kirik Party is the story of a gang of mischievous students, lead by the protagonist Karna (Rakshit Shetty), who has just joined an engineering college.

metas.name: Shahid
metas.description: The account of Human Rights lawyer Shahid Azmi, an ordinary citizen with an extraordinary commitment to justice.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Chak De! India
metas.description: Kabir Khan, the coach of the Indian Women's National Hockey Team, dreams of making his all-girls team emerge victorious against all odds.

metas.name: The Tashkent Files
metas.description: Revolves around the mysterious death of India's 2nd Prime Minister Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri and attempts to uncover if he had actually died a natural death, or, as alleged, was assassinated.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: With Spider-Man's identity now revealed, Peter asks Doctor Strange for help. When a spell goes wrong, dangerous foes from other worlds start to appear.

metas.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
metas.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

metas.name: Okkadu
metas.description: A Kabbadi player rescues a young woman from an unwanted marriage and hides her in his home.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A seventeen-year-old aristocrat falls in love with a kind but poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated R.M.S. Titanic.

metas.name: Kick
metas.description: An adrenaline junkie's quest for kicks leads him to a life of crime.

metas.name: Vettaiyaadu Vilaiyaadu
metas.description: A Police Officer investigates a series of brutal rapes and murders, with the culprits seeming to cover more than one country.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: Baron "Bear" Bailey breaks a novelty charm to force his co-worker Nikki Freeman to love him, but the supernatural compulsion warps her mind into violent obsession, trapping him in a nightmare he cannot wish away.

metas.name: Ugly
metas.description: The case of a missing girl takes us through a journey of human greed and brushes upon the egos and repressed emotions of the characters.

metas.name: Rockstar
metas.description: Janardhan Jakhar chases his dreams of becoming a big Rock star, during which he falls in love with Heer.

metas.name: Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
metas.description: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.

metas.name: Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!
metas.description: Lovinder Singh, a thief now in custody and facing trial, reflects on his life of crime while the press reflect on how he managed to get away with so much before being arrested.

metas.name: Mr. India
metas.description: A poor but big-hearted man takes orphans into his home. After discovering his scientist father's invisibility device, he rises to the occasion and fights to save his children and all of India from the clutches of a megalomaniac.

metas.name: Bridge of Spies
metas.description: During the Cold War, an American lawyer is recruited to defend an arrested Soviet spy in court, and then help the CIA facilitate an exchange of the spy for the Soviet captured American U2 spy plane pilot, Francis Gary Powers.

metas.name: The Whale
metas.description: A reclusive, morbidly obese English teacher attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter.

metas.name: Children's Party
metas.description: A gang of innocent but feisty kids who lead carefree lives in Chandan Nagar colony takes on the big bad world of politics when one of their friend's life is endangered.

metas.name: Kill
metas.description: During a train trip to New Delhi, a pair of commandos face an army of invading bandits.

metas.name: Ghajini
metas.description: A short-term memory loss patient goes on a killing spree in order to avenge the death of his ladylove.

metas.name: The Judge
metas.description: Big-city lawyer Hank Palmer returns to his childhood home where his father, the town's judge, is suspected of murder. Hank sets out to discover the truth; along the way he reconnects with his estranged family.

metas.name: HIT: The 3rd Case
metas.description: Arjun Sarkaar, a top HIT officer from Visakhapatnam, is sent to Jammu and Kashmir to investigate a series of brutal murders. As he pursues a group of elusive killers, the case tests his skills and mental strength.

metas.name: Dear Comrade
metas.description: A hot-blooded student union leader falls for a state-level cricketer but his anger management issues and violent streak threatens to derail their love story.

metas.name: Mrs. Chatterjee vs. Norway
metas.description: An immigrant Indian mother's battle against the Norwegian foster care system and local legal machinery to win back the custody of her children.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: The Post
metas.description: A cover-up spanning four U.S. Presidents pushes the country's first female newspaper publisher and her editor to join an unprecedented battle between press and government.

metas.name: Table No. 21
metas.description: A couple is drawn into a game show with a whooping winning prize. However the game turns into more than a survival for them with no escape.

metas.name: Toilet: A Love Story
metas.description: A woman threatens to leave her husband unless he installs a toilet in their home. To win back her love and respect, he heads out on a journey to fight against the backward society.

metas.name: Avatar: Fire and Ash
metas.description: Jake and Neytiri's family grapples with grief, encountering a new, aggressive Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, who are led by the fiery Varang, as the conflict on Pandora escalates and a new moral focus emerges.

metas.name: Agni
metas.description: In a city plagued by a strange rise in fires, fireman Vithal and his policeman brother-in-law Samit reluctantly team up to solve the escalating crisis. Battling personal conflicts, they race against time to crack the case and save...

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz
metas.description: A newly married couple's life falls in jeopardy when the wife goes missing under mysterious circumstances.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.

metas.name: The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist
metas.description: A father-to-be tries to figure out what is happening with all this AI insanity.
